display.title: The Rashbi and the Alter Rebbe at the Parade
display.summary_short: For Lag BaOmer: a boy revived at the Rashbi's resting place in Meron, and why the Rashbi and even the Alter Rebbe come to a children's rally.
display.summary_long: The storyteller tells of a miracle on Lag BaOmer 5683 in Meron, witnessed by Rabbi Shaya Margulies. A mother who had prayed for a child in the merit of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai brings her son for his upsherin, as she promised. On Shabbos the boy suddenly falls ill and passes away, and doctors quarantine the area. The mother carries him to the Rashbi's kever and begs the tzaddik not to send her away empty-handed. Everyone is sent out, and moments later the boy is heard calling for water, alive and healthy, and all bless Hashem who revives the dead. The storyteller then shares the Rebbe's words that the Rashbi is present at the Lag BaOmer parade, so it makes no sense to leave early, and tells a story he heard from his father: at a 1946 rally the Rebbe held in the backyard of 770, the Frierdiker Rebbe watched from a window and later told the Rebbe that the Alter Rebbe had come too. Finally he explains how the Alter Rebbe and Rabbi Levi Yitzchak of Berditchev settled differences over V'shamru and the Al HaMichyah blessing with a friendly compromise.
display.lesson: At a Lag BaOmer parade we stand in the presence of tzaddikim, so we should stay, take part and ask for brachos; and making peace through compromise is always good.

date.hebrew: Iyar 5784, a few days before Lag BaOmer
date.note: Says the Meron miracle of Lag BaOmer 5683 was '101 years ago' and the parade is 'in a few days'; Lag BaOmer 5784 = 26 May 2024.

advisories.note: A three-year-old boy dies suddenly and is brought back to life at the Rashbi's resting place.
Doctors fear a contagious disease and quarantine the area.

sources_cited.note: At a farbrengen after Lag BaOmer, the Rebbe said the Rashbi is present at the parade.
The Frierdiker Rebbe's story to the Rebbe about the Alter Rebbe and Rabbi Levi Yitzchak's 'yarid'.
The Alter Rebbe's siddur: V'shamru on Friday night and the end of Al HaMichyah.
